# SunSpec model definitions

Copied verbatim from [sunspec/models](https://github.com/sunspec/models)
(`json/model_<id>.json`, commit `90b4a331`, August 2026), © SunSpec Alliance,
under the [Apache License 2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).

`test/sunspec.test.js` checks the point offsets of `src/profiles/sunspec.js`
against these definitions: the common model (1), the inverters (101-103,
111-113) and the meters (201-204, 211-214).
